parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Build explicit hypotheses from public findings without turning internal unknowns into facts.

OWNER
GRETEL TRACK B

INPUT CONTRACT
Paola track output: run_context, findings[], evidence[], unknowns[]

OUTPUT CONTRACT
Accumulated payload plus hypotheses[] conforming to hypothesis.schema.json

STATUS
Phase 2B repository-ready. Inactive by default. No credentials. Deterministic fixture path; no Python execution.

VISIBLE PATH
Input findings + evidence + unknowns -> Can internal reality be observed?
YES -> preserve observed interpretation
NO -> build hypothesis -> confidence + validation gap -> structured hypotheses
Every hypothesis requires validation and carries finding/evidence IDs.

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, interpretation: 'observed', hypothesis_record: null } }));
